text: The 1382 test selects one address book and calendar, arms a calendar-registration observer and addrbook-directory-synced promise, then clicks Continue. It verifies the directory type and exact CardDAV URL plus calendar name and type, and removes the created resources. For this historical flow test, recommend retaining backend assertions and waits rather than asserting only checked boxes or a success label. The accepted test has moved to browser_accountHubSyncAccounts.js and is registered in browser.toml. It retains backend waits and assertions while submitting with Enter. Both historical and current test source were read; neither was run. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: The sync browser test arms backend observers before Continue
